nodes.label: The tool's license, the copyright status of the extracted media, and the service's contractual terms are three independent axes; a permissive tool license conveys nothing on the media and cannot override a contract
nodes.norm_label: the tool license the copyright status of the extracted media and the service contractual terms are three independent axes

nodes.label: The licence of what you ship depends on the yt-dlp artifact: the git repo, PyPI sdist and wheel are Unlicense-only, but the PyInstaller-bundled standalone executables include GPLv3+ code, so bundling one inside a commercial closed-source Tauri app imposes copyleft obligations
nodes.norm_label: the licence of what you ship depends on the yt-dlp artifact

nodes.label: The 2020 RIAA DMCA notice against youtube-dl targeted how the tool presented and demonstrated its audio-extraction capability, naming three specific commercial songs and an M4A extraction example, not the mere existence of the tool
nodes.norm_label: the 2020 riaa dmca notice against youtube-dl targeted how the tool presented and demonstrated its audio-extraction capability not the mere existence of the tool
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - r3-legal-and-tos-surface [ses_f24bc7334ffeONkWu1YZEa5AAr].md:L15644] The one real enforcement action in this space attached to how the tool demonstrated and marketed its audio-extraction capability, naming specific commercial works, which is a presentation-and-positioning risk vector rather than a capability risk

nodes.label: YouTube's Required Minimum Functionality document contains no enumeration of supported operating systems, browsers or rendering engines, so the embed is contractually neither permitted nor forbidden on Linux and the WebKitGTK playback failure is a technical fact rather than a licensing one
nodes.norm_label: youtube required minimum functionality document contains no enumeration of supported operating systems browsers or rendering engines
